title: RSVP for the next Melbourne RHUG!
description:
**REGISTER HERE: [https://reg.experiences.redhat.com/flow/redhat/4816596/rhexpressregistration/page/expressregistration?sc\_cid=RHCTN1260000493939](https://reg.experiences.redhat.com/flow/redhat/4816596/rhexpressregistration/page/expressregistration?sc_cid=RHCTN1260000493939)**  
Hi,  
Transitioning to image-mode operating systems provides immutability, but verifying and trusting the operating system underneath your applications requires a clear assurance strategy.  
Join us for the next [Melbourne Red Hat User Group (RHUG)](https://reg.experiences.redhat.com/flow/redhat/4816596/rhexpressregistration/page/expressregistration?sc_cid=RHCTN1260000493939) meeting to examine a practical field report on moving from basic immutable images to fully assured boot states using CI/CD pipelines and bootc.

\### Key Topics

-   OS Assurance: Moving beyond basic immutability to verify and trust the operating system layer.
-   CI/CD Integration: Leveraging bootc and CI/CD pipelines to automate image-mode OS creation and deployment.
-   Field Report Insights: Lessons drawn from homelab implementations and defense/intelligence engineering requirements.
-   Networking: Connect with local IT leaders and peers over food and drinks.

\### [Event Details](https://reg.experiences.redhat.com/flow/redhat/4816596/rhexpressregistration/page/expressregistration?sc_cid=RHCTN1260000493939)

-   Date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026
-   Time: 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM ET
-   Location: One Oak, 1800 W Hibiscus Blvd #108, Melbourne, FL 32901
-   Includes: Food, drinks, and networking

If you have any questions, email [rhug@redhat.com.](http://rhug@redhat.com.)  
Best regards,
